title: At Sunny Cafe
text:
This is the menu at Sunny Cafe. There are three kinds of soup. The soup of the day is tomato soup. A sandwich costs five dollars.

The drinks are on the right side of the menu. You can order tea, coffee, or orange juice. Dessert is at the bottom of the menu. The cake is very good.

questions.text: How much does a sandwich cost?
Where are the drinks on the menu?
What can you infer about Sunny Cafe?
options: It is a shop for toys.
It is open only at night.

questions.text: Which item would a person who likes sweet food probably choose?

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks in a restaurant or cafe
a warm liquid food, often made from vegetables or meat
to ask for food or drink in a restaurant
something sweet that you eat at the end of a meal

paragraph_translations: Bu, Sunny Cafe'nin menüsü. Üç çeşit çorba var. Günün çorbası domates çorbası. Bir sandviç beş dolara mal olur.
İçecekler menünün sağ tarafında. Çay, kahve veya portakal suyu sipariş edebilirsiniz. Tatlılar menünün en altında. Pasta çok lezzetli.
